guides.definition: Uses Boost.StringAlgo to remove leading and trailing whitespace. Project dependency only: configure the required Boost headers and libraries in a C++ project; the isolated snippet runner does not resolve external packages.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Name of the std::string to create and trim.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: String expression containing optional surrounding whitespace.

examples.title: Trim user input
examples.explanation: trim mutates the supplied string; trim_copy is available when the original should be retained.

guides.definition: Creates a Boost.Asio steady timer and runs its completion handler on an io_context. Project dependency only: configure the required Boost headers and libraries in a C++ project; the isolated snippet runner does not resolve external packages.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Number of seconds before the timer becomes ready.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Value written when the timer completes successfully.

examples.title: Wait one second
examples.explanation: The io_context drives asynchronous completion; the handler checks cancellation or other timer errors before using the result.

guides.definition: Declares a Boost.Program_options description and parses the process arguments. Project dependency only: configure the required Boost headers and libraries in a C++ project; the isolated snippet runner does not resolve external packages.

parameters.name: caption
parameters.description: Heading displayed with the option list.

parameters.name: optionName
parameters.description: Long command-line option name without leading dashes.

parameters.name: defaultValue
parameters.description: Default string value when the option is omitted.

examples.title: Parse an output option
examples.explanation: The option description owns names, value types, defaults, and help text; notify performs semantic conversion and validation.
